messages.速度6以上で味方より先にS3「迅速制圧」を撃ち、そのターン中に効く脆弱を入れて、: A Pierce attacker built for short fights and spending all his ammunition. At 6 or more Speed, use S3 Quick Suppression before allies act to inflict Fragile for the current turn, then let the following attacks finish the enemy.
messages.S3「迅速制圧」: 5コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時に脆弱2ずつ(1ターンの間有効: **S3 — Quick Suppression**: 5 Coins. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each inflict 2 Fragile on hit (lasting 1 turn), and Coins Ⅲ–Ⅴ inflict 1, 2, and 3 Rupture. Fragile takes effect the turn it is applied, so acting fast and letting following attacks benefit from it is strong.
messages.速度6以上で強化: 速度6以上のとき、S2「集中射撃」はコイン威力+1、S3はコ: **Bonuses at 6 or more Speed**: At 6 or more Speed, S2 Concentrated Fire gains +1 Coin Power and S3 gains +2 Coin Power. His Speed range is 3–5 (3–6 and 3–7 at higher Uptie), so at stages with a low cap, make up for it with the passive's Haste and similar.
messages.弾丸: 1回の使用で、S1「草食み」はⅠ・Ⅱコインで2、S2はⅠ〜Ⅲコインで3、: **Ammo**: Per use, S1 Graze the Grass spends 2 with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, S2 spends 3 with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ, and S3 spends 2 with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ. Cycling through his skills once (3× S1, 2× S2, 1× S3) uses 14 rounds in total. The only refill in the data is the passive Raring to Graze's "+3 Ammo at stage start." He starts with 13 (16 including the passive). When he runs out, Coins that spend Ammo are removed when attacking (Clashes still use all Coins).
messages.S2「集中射撃」: Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインの的中時に出血1ずつ付与する。: **S2 — Concentrated Fire**: Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ each inflict 1 Bleed on hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「草を食む準備」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターン開: **Combat passive — Raring to Graze (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At the start of the next turn, Charge Count increases by Wrath Resonance. With 5 or more Charge Count, he gains 1 Haste and 1 Attack Power Up. Charge Count also increases on Coin Ⅲ hit of S1 and when using the Defense skill Evade.
messages.速度6以上を確保して、S3を味方より先に撃って脆弱を入れ、後続の攻撃でまとめて削: Secure 6 or more Speed, fire S3 before allies to inflict Fragile, and let following attacks wear the enemy down together. Even with the passive, his Ammo only covers a little over one cycle of skills, with no way to refill. So in long fights, or battles where Ammo carries over across waves, replace S1 and S2 with Evade or E.G.O to conserve Ammo. His damage drops when he runs dry, so he tends to perform best later in team order. In the current environment, spanning the three keywords Bleed, Rupture, and Charge is the reason he is used in the Mirror Dungeon.
